Command that this Stone

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

‘Command that this stone become a loaf.’—M
ATT.
 
IV.
 3
.
A
ND
 so it was; bread was that stone;
Such bread, Christ, as was all Thine own.
Since God so will’d that it should be.
To have no bread was bread to Thee.
